source_note: WorldPop Ghana 2020, unconstrained 100m gridded population count (data.worldpop.org, id 6365). Each pixel is an estimated person-count, summed per zone -- not a census, a model-based estimate. Building counts here are a CLEAN centroid-based assignment (one cell per building, no double-counting) -- deliberately different from channel_encroachment_index.py's n_buildings, which uses a padded/overlapping bbox appropriate for its own distance-to-waterway calculation but wrong for a district-wide infrastructure total (summing it double-counts buildings near cell edges: 228,330 vs. 123,944 unique buildings in the same area -- caught and fixed here, not shipped).
